answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Reaching the pulse of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The timber is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the raven. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, forfeited on duplicate submission, no identity may audit its own recruit.
